event.title: Boyos Wonderland x INI Movement Present: Summer Jam
event.description: A one day mini-festival at Houtbaar Haarlem where Boyos Wonderland and INI Movement meet: live energy, DJs, musicians, pop-up tattoos and people coming together for the same reason: to move.

finalCta.title: Meet us where the garden turns into a dancefloor.
finalCta.body: Summer Jam brings Boyos Wonderland and INI Movement together for a full day of open jam energy, DJs, live musicians, pop-up tattoos and warm selections. We start outside at Houtbaar in Haarlem, then move inside after 23:00 and keep going till 02:00. Tickets start at €20 through Houtbaar.

concept: Summer Jam is where Boyos Wonderland and INI Movement meet at Houtbaar: a one day mini-festival in the garden, built around live energy, DJs, musicians and people coming together for the same reason: to move.

The garden opens in the afternoon with jams and DJ sets moving through the day, hosted by SYNGA as the voice carrying the energy between the garden and the stage. As the evening builds, Estafête brings live musicians into the room and the dancefloor starts to heat up.
Around it all: a pop-up tattoo studio, familiar faces, new friends, and that easy summer feeling of staying a little longer than you planned.
When the garden closes at 23:00, the night moves inside and keeps going until 02:00.

lineup.name: Open Jam
lineup.description: The open jam is not a fixed show slot or a closed band moment. It is the loose, participatory pulse of the afternoon: musicians, friends and the garden finding the rhythm together.

lineup.name: SYNGA
lineup.description: SYNGA is the voice guiding Summer Jam through the day: hosting the open jams and Estafête, bringing soulful R&B instinct, synth textures and raw beat energy into the garden.

lineup.name: Estafête
lineup.description: Estafête is a live formation put together for movement, not a traditional band with a fixed front. DJs and musicians pass energy back and forth, letting the set build in the moment.

lineup.name: TOMMASO
lineup.description: Tommaso Conforti is a Florence-born, Chicago-based vinyl selector and record digger with a deep ear for house music history and global rarities. His sets connect forgotten gems, soulful club records and forward-moving dancefloor moments. He is also behind Elevator Music Live, a platform creating space for artists and live dance music culture between Chicago and wider dancefloor communities.

lineup.name: UMOJA
lineup.description: UMOJA are a Dutch DJ and producer duo with a name that means togetherness. Their sound moves through global grooves, percussion, bass, and warm club energy, always with the feeling of people meeting each other on the floor.

lineup.name: Shamis
lineup.description: Shamis is a producer, DJ, vocalist, and co-founder of INI Movement. His work blends soulful electronics, live instinct, and community energy, making him a natural guide between the jam, the stage, and the late-night room.

lineup.name: Boyos Soundsystem
lineup.description: Boyos Soundsystem bring the essential groove at the heart of the day: disco, house, Brazilian boogie, soca, zouk, italo, afro house, and the kind of selections that make a garden feel like a shared living room.
